scope: Complete legal-state rule-by-component specification for a PREAUTHENTICATED shared-DAG record calculus with heterogeneous allowed FUSE widths. NOT a general physical Turing-machine model.

state.immutable: D (G distinct globally paid identities), J (q pending scales), E (nonempty activation batches covering J), E_b subset E for each integer b>=1
state.mutable: P subset D globally checked, U subset J pending, h in {0,1}, v in {0,1} reversible metadata
state.goal: P=D, U=empty, h=0, both metadata views

exactDefinitions.tau(U): integer minimum number of sets from E whose union covers U; tau(empty)=0
exactDefinitions.sigma(t): max({0} union {b+tau(J)-tau(J\S)-1 : 1<=b<=t and S in E_b})
exactDefinitions.p(C): (0,0,tau(U),0,t-c*sigma(t),0,h) for h=1; all zeros for completed goal

rowSchema.post: v toggled (VIEW) or unchanged (NOP); P,U,h fixed

rowSchema.pre: h=1, P=D, S in E, S intersect U nonempty
h=1, t=b, U=J, S in E_b

freeScc: exactly {v=0,v=1} at fixed (P,U,h); all cost-zero potential changes zero

certificate.minimumValueProof: Explicit CHECK-to-b,FUSE_b,remaining optimal BATCH cover,distinct HALT attains V; any completion without FUSE costs t+tau(U)+h; at most one FUSE can occur because FUSE requires U=J and removes nonempty S

fullFiniteRowGenerator: experiments/tmr/tmr5_mixedwidth_fuse044.js produces full per-model signed concrete rows and shortest completion checks on execution.
